item.title: Major milestone reached at Ovingham to protect the River Tyne’s wildlife
item.description: Northumbrian Water has reached a major milestone in its £11m environmental programme at Ovingham, with the first pair of new eel screens successfully installed at the raw water pumping station. The installation forms a key part of the company’s ongoing commitment to protecting the European eel, a species classified as critically endangered, as well as other fish populations within the River Tyne.
